headline: Public hearings on nine traffic petitions, including parking limits, stop signs, a traffic-calming petition, and an honorary street sign.
summary: The agenda lists nine traffic petitions for public hearing. They cover parking rules, stop signs, a traffic-calming petition, and an honorary street sign.
